content:
You're with a client. The phone rings. You can't pick up.

Most callers don't leave a voicemail. They call the next business on Google.

Missed call text back fixes this. The second a call goes unanswered, they get a text from your business number: "Sorry we missed you, how can we help?" The conversation keeps going, and they book with you instead.

It runs 24/7 and you set it up once.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#smallbusiness #missedcalls #automation

A new lead fills in your form. They're interested right now, and they've probably contacted two or three other businesses too.

Whoever replies first gets the conversation. Whoever replies tomorrow gets ignored.

Automate the first reply: a text and an email within seconds of every new lead, with a link to book. Your team picks it up from there.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#speedtolead #sales #leadgeneration

You paid to get every contact in your list. Most businesses never speak to them again.

A reactivation campaign sends a simple, personal message to past enquiries and old customers: a reason to come back, and an easy way to book.

It's often the cheapest source of new bookings a business has.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#databasereactivation #marketing #smallbusiness

The first week decides whether a new member sticks.

Automate it:
- Welcome text the day they join
- Check-in after their first class
- Nudge if they haven't booked a second visit
- Offer to upgrade before the trial ends

No one on the front desk has to remember any of it.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#gymowner #fitnessbusiness #membership

Your Instagram bio. Your Google Business Profile. Your email signature. Your website header. Every text you send.

Every extra step between "I'm interested" and "I'm booked" loses people.

One online booking calendar, linked everywhere, with automatic confirmations and reminders.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#onlinebooking #smallbusiness #marketingtips

A sales funnel walks a visitor through one clear path: a problem they recognise, an offer that solves it, and one action to take.

Then the follow-up takes over: texts, emails and reminders until they book or buy.

Most businesses don't need more traffic. They need the traffic they already have to convert.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#salesfunnel #marketing #conversion

- Answer questions about your services, prices and hours
- Qualify leads with a few simple questions
- Book appointments straight into your calendar
- Reply on website chat, Facebook, Instagram and text
- Hand anything sensitive or complex to a person

It works at 2am on a Sunday, and it never forgets to follow up.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#ai #aiagents #smallbusiness

Six-month check-ups are easy to forget, for patients and for busy front desks.

Automated recall reminders by text and email, with a link to book, bring patients back on time. Missed appointments get a follow-up to rebook.

Your team spends less time on the phone and more time with patients.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#dentalpractice #dentist #patientcare

A funnel to capture leads. A calendar for discovery calls. Payments for your programme. A course area for members. A community for clients. Email to stay in touch.

All in one place, with one login and one bill.

Unlimited contacts and users, from $67 a month.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#coaching #onlinecoach #courses

In many countries, WhatsApp is how people prefer to talk to businesses.

Answer WhatsApp messages from the same inbox as your texts and emails, send confirmations and reminders, and let an AI agent handle common questions.

Your team stays on one screen.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#whatsapp #whatsappbusiness #customerservice

New enquiry. Contacted. Booked. Showed up. Won. Lost.

A sales pipeline shows every lead and deal by stage, so nothing sits forgotten in an inbox. Automations can move leads along for you when they book, pay or go quiet.

If you can see it, you can fix it.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#salespipeline #crm #sales

Before you send a campaign, make sure your domain is set up properly: SPF, DKIM and DMARC records tell inbox providers your emails are really from you.

Then keep it simple: a clear subject, one message, one link, and an easy way to unsubscribe.

Good setup plus good habits gets you to the inbox.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#emailmarketing #deliverability #smallbusiness

Who enquired, when, about what. What they bought. When they last visited. What you promised to send them.

A CRM keeps it all in one record per customer, and automations use that history to send the right message at the right time.

You don't need a complicated CRM. You need one you actually use.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#crm #customerrelationships #smallbusiness

Referrals are great. But where does a referral go when they look you up?

If they find a slow website, no booking link and a voicemail, many of them move on quietly.

A simple funnel with instant replies and online booking makes sure warm referrals actually turn into customers.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#referrals #salesfunnel #smallbusiness

Every extra field is another reason to leave.

Ask only what you need to reply properly: name, phone or email, and one question about what they need.

Then let the automation handle the rest: instant reply, tag by interest, and the right follow-up sequence.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#leadcapture #forms #conversion

Someone in pain is searching right now and booking with whoever responds.

Instant replies to calls, forms and messages, online booking for a first visit, intake forms sent automatically, and recall reminders after treatment.

More enquiries become patients, and patients finish their care plans.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#chiropractor #physiotherapy #patientcare

Replying shows future customers you care, and it keeps happy customers coming back.

Thank the good ones by name. Answer the bad ones calmly, and offer to fix it offline.

Manage review requests and replies from one place, so none slip through.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#reviews #reputationmanagement #localbusiness

Groups, posts, events, courses and member payments in one place, connected to your CRM and email.

New members get onboarded automatically, and failed payments get reminders before access is lost.

Your community, your brand, your customer list.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#community #onlinecommunity #membership

"Which treatment is right for me?" "What's your home worth?" "Which plan fits your business?"

A short quiz is engaging, captures contact details, and tells you what each lead needs. Then the follow-up matches their answers.

Better leads, better conversations.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#leadgeneration #quiz #marketing

Members book classes online, get reminders, and pay monthly automatically. New leads get a trial offer and a follow-up sequence. Members who stop coming get a friendly check-in.

Your studio runs smoothly, and fewer members drift away quietly.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#yogastudio #pilates #fitnessstudio

When your website, forms, chat, booking and CRM are all in one place, every visitor who reaches out gets an instant reply and lands in your pipeline.

No copying leads between apps. No enquiries lost in an inbox.

Build your site, connect your domain and start catching leads.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#website #webdesign #leadgeneration

For most small businesses, the answer is yes. Every reply, reminder and follow-up depends on someone remembering.

The goal isn't to work less. It's to stop losing customers when you're busy, off or asleep.

That's what a 24/7 system is for.

Questions? Ask in the comments.

#smallbusiness #entrepreneur #automation
